title: Ka’anapali Beach Parasail - Maui
specs: Flights up to 1,200 feet above West Maui coast
Dry takeoff and landing on boat deck, no swimming required
Views of resort strip, Black Rock, Lahaina, Lānaʻi, Molokaʻi, and West Maui Mountains
Crew speaks English, Spanish and Japanese
The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs.
Minimum age 5 years, no upper age limit
Waiver signed by parent or guardian for under 18

The Captain will let out 1,000 Ft of line and off you go! 1-3 people can fly at the same time. Some restrictions apply depending on weight and wind conditions; ultimately it’s the Captain’s decision. blurb: Guests fly solo, tandem, or triple on a parasail with dry takeoff and landing from a boat. Flights last 8 to 14 minutes in the air, with the whole trip about an hour including shuttle from the beach. The operation runs May 16 to December 14, with USCG-certified captains and safety equipment.
